codeReview.summary: Fail with one blocking issue. The commit adds first-class `flux git generate-spec`, `plan-registration`, and `register-and-verify` handlers, parses the expected flags, and surfaces reusable resource-backed payloads. But the runtime wiring still leaves launcher keep-alive enabled for one-shot Git deploy planning flows, so JSON automation can hang instead of exiting cleanly.

issues.description: In commit `4a6d6d95`, `handleGitPlanRegistration` calls `flux_git_deploy_plan_registration` without disabling MCP launcher keep-alive for non-pretty output, and the `git` command path still constructs a raw default runtime instead of a one-shot-safe wrapper. The worker's own smoke evidence says `node fluxos-cli/dist/index.js git plan-registration --json ...` printed valid JSON but stayed alive until timeout unless `FLUX_MCP_LOCAL_LAUNCHER=0`, so this finalized slice did not yet satisfy the intended automation-safe CLI contract. Commit `9895d2c6` later adds `setLauncherKeepAlive` / `getCommandToolRuntime` to fix exactly this gap.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The mission shared library does not document the launcher keep-alive caveat for one-shot CLI commands, so workers have to rediscover that launcher-producing plan flows can hang unless keep-alive is explicitly disabled.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: The `0b94b549-344b-4532-a74c-7cd56cd7c2b8` transcript shows repeated investigation of launcher state, `FLUX_MCP_LOCAL_LAUNCHER`, and `unref()` after the Git plan smoke hung; the handoff's `discoveredIssues[0]` records the same timeout behavior. `rg -n "FLUX_MCP_LOCAL_LAUNCHER|launcher" /home/stache/projects/flux-skills/.factory/library` returned no matches.
